title: Return agency to the Creator
summary: Pain becomes medicine when it exposes the false claim that the self is in charge. Return agency to the Creator whose light and work pervade everything.
takeaway: Let pain loosen the claim that you are carrying reality alone.
lifeApplication: When pain makes you clench for control, say plainly, “You are the Doer,” and release one outcome you were pretending to command.

source.shortMeaning: Suffering can reveal the truth that the Creator acts where self-effort cannot command reality.
source.lifeApplication: Let pain uncover the false authorship you were trying to hold.

evidence.coreClaim: Suffering can reveal the truth that the Creator acts where self-effort cannot command reality.
evidence.turn: The shabad turns pain from resentment into surrender by returning action, power, and praise to the Creator.
evidence.practicalImplication: When pain makes you clench for control, say plainly, “You are the Doer,” and release one outcome you were pretending to command.
